questions: Is the cost of swapping P_i and P_{i+1} always exactly i, regardless of the values being swapped, or does it depend on the positions after previous swaps?
Does 'ascending order' mean sorted as (1, 2, ..., N) specifically, or just non-decreasing order of the values present?
Can we perform multiple operations simultaneously or only one at a time?
Is the goal to minimize total cost, allowing any sequence of swaps, or must we find the optimal sequence under the given cost structure?
If multiple optimal sequences exist, are we to output the minimum cost (which is the same), or any other property?
Are we allowed to swap the same pair multiple times, possibly increasing cost unnecessarily?
Does the cost i refer to the position before the swap, and does it change if we swap elements that later move to different positions?
Is there any constraint on the number of operations, or can we perform arbitrarily many as long as we pay the cost?
